meta.wiki: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout

summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard awaits a stout blended with Zanzil's Mixture. Crank Fizzlebub calls it Fool's Stout and believes Kravel needs it, so you carry it to him on the Shimmering Flats before it spoils.

sections.title: A Libation for Kravel
sections.body: Crank Fizzlebub has blended Zanzil's Mixture into stout, making a potent drink he calls Fool's Stout. He believes Kravel needs it and wants to hear how it works. So you carry the drink to Kravel Koalbeard at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats.

sections.title: Do Not Let It Sit
sections.body: Crank warns you not to keep the stout long. The mixture drives the yeast into high gear, and the drink will not stay fresh forever.

faq.q: Who sends you on this delivery?
aliases: who starts zanzil's mixture and a fool's stout
faq.answer: Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay gives you Fool's Stout to carry.

aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard receives Fool's Stout at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Why does the drink need to be delivered quickly?
faq.answer: The mixture drives the yeast hard, so stout that sits too long goes off.
It follows Back to Booty Bay and Zanzil's Secret.

faq.q: What comes after delivering the stout?
faq.answer: The chain continues with Fool's Stout, Get the Gnomes Drunk and Get the Goblins Drunk.
